prompt.en: Review an improvement claim supported only by a presentation slide. What additional evidence would strengthen assessment?

explanation.en: Strong evidence for an improvement claim combines a sustained trend in the result, records showing the approach was deployed where it should be, and a credible link between the change and the result. A slide alone is an assertion.

prompt.en: What best distinguishes an excellence model from a management-system standard such as ISO 9001?
prompt.ar: ما الذي يميز نموذج التميز على النحو الأفضل عن معيار نظام إدارة مثل ISO 9001؟

text.en: An excellence model is a non-prescriptive framework for judging how well the whole organisation creates value; a standard sets requirements to conform to
text.ar: نموذج التميز إطار غير إلزامي للحكم على مدى جودة صنع المنظمة كلها للقيمة؛ والمعيار يضع متطلبات تجب المطابقة لها

why.en: Right: one judges maturity, the other checks conformity.
why.ar: صحيح: أحدهما يحكم على النضج والآخر يتحقق من المطابقة.

text.en: An excellence model is a stricter certification standard
text.ar: نموذج التميز معيار منح أكثر صرامة

why.en: It is not a certification standard.

text.en: They are the same thing with different names
An excellence model only covers customer satisfaction
text.ar: نموذج التميز يغطي رضا العملاء فقط

why.en: It covers the whole organisation and all stakeholders.
why.ar: يغطي المنظمة كلها وجميع أصحاب المصلحة.

explanation.en: Standards define requirements to conform to; an excellence model is a framework to judge and improve overall maturity.
explanation.ar: تحدد المعايير متطلبات للمطابقة؛ ونموذج التميز إطار للحكم على النضج الكلي وتحسينه.

prompt.en: Plan and pilot a self-assessment of one criterion with two colleagues: write the plan (scope, sponsor, team, evidence call, timeline), record evidence and findings in the EFQM Assessment Lab, hold a 60-minute consensus session, and export a short report with three recommended priorities. Label it as a self-assessment aid.
